### A Lying Amalekite
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lying-amalekite
Passage: 2 Samuel 1:14
Points:
- An Amalekite brought Saul’s crown to David, claiming he had killed Saul to gain favor and a reward.
- The messenger misjudged David, assuming David harbored malice and would celebrate his enemy's death.
- David had consistently respected Saul’s divine appointment and refused to lift his own hand against God’s anointed.
- Because the man confessed to killing the Lord’s anointed, David ordered his execution rather than rewarding him.
- Attempting to advance oneself through deceit fails before God, who holds people accountable for truthfulness.
